spriteSheetComponent.name: CoinSprite
spriteSheetComponent.event: --some hacks to check what context we are in if element:root():GetElement("SelectedMonsterView") then -- BOM context? local islandType = game.getBookOfMonstersIslandType(); if(game.isEtherealIsland(islandType)) then component("spriteName"):SetString(game.StoreContext_SPRITE_ETH_CURRENCY) elseif(game.isAmberIsland(islandType)) then component("spriteName"):SetString(game.StoreContext_SPRITE_RELIC) else component("spriteName"):SetString(game.StoreContext_SPRITE_COINS) end else -- use current island component("spriteName"):SetString(game.objectRateUnitCurrencySprite()) end component("sheetName"):SetString(game.StoreContext_CURRENCY_SPRITESHEET) component("size"):SetFloat(0.3*game.menuScaleX()) component("layer"):SetString("FrontPopUps")

textComponent.name: Text
textComponent.event:
component("font"):Set(game.getTextFont()) component("size"):SetFloat(0.22*game.menuScaleX()) component("alignment"):SetInt(lua_sys.MenuTextComponent_TEXT_LEFT_ALIGNED)
--some hacks to check what context we are in if element:root():GetElement("SelectedMonsterView") then -- BoM context? component("text"):SetString(PrettyNumber(game.monsterTypeResourceRate(element:parent():parent():parent()("selectedMonster"):GetInt(), game.getBookOfMonstersIslandType()))) elseif game.storeContext() then -- store context component("text"):SetString(PrettyNumber(store:ItemCoinsPerMin(element:parent()("ItemIndex"):GetInt()))) else -- or maybe just set it before calling init? local selectedMonster = 0 if element:HasVar("monsterID") then selectedMonster = element("monsterID"):GetInt() end if selectedMonster > 0 then local islandType = game.currentIslandType() component("text"):SetString(PrettyNumber(game.monsterTypeResourceRate(selectedMonster, islandType))) end end
component("layer"):SetString("FrontPopUps") component("autoScaleFactor"):SetFloat(0.01) component("autoScale"):SetInt(1)

textComponent.name: Suffix
textComponent.event: component("font"):Set(game.getTextFont()) component("size"):SetFloat(0.22*game.menuScaleX()) component("alignment"):SetInt(lua_sys.MenuTextComponent_TEXT_LEFT_ALIGNED) --some hacks to check what context we are in if element:root():GetElement("SelectedMonsterView") then -- BoM context? local islandType = game.getBookOfMonstersIslandType(); if game.isEtherealIsland(islandType) then component("text"):SetString("ETH_RATE_UNIT") elseif game.isAmberIsland(islandType) then component("text"):SetString("AMBER_RATE_UNIT") else component("text"):SetString("RATE_UNIT") end else if game.isEtherealIsland() then component("text"):SetString("ETH_RATE_UNIT") elseif game.isAmberIsland() then component("text"):SetString("AMBER_RATE_UNIT") else component("text"):SetString("RATE_UNIT") end end component("layer"):SetString("FrontPopUps") component("autoScaleFactor"):SetFloat(0.01) component("autoScale"):SetInt(1)
